tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures support a coupled memory transient, but five observations do not identify its four parameters reliably. The fine trajectory batch is the relevant probe and provides the additional observations needed before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled 2-state memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Only five rows are available; the archive specifies that this four-parameter mechanism requires at least eight rows, so its parameters are not adequately identifiable.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static or simpler transient law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The coupled-transient-lag signature and varied memory inputs make these alternatives inadequately supported for the requested forecast horizon.
It is not relevant to identifying the target law.
